messages:
Caroline: Heads-up — cutting the 'orchard' base image rebuild this Thu 10:00 UTC. We need RBAC updates for the image signer, KMS ACL tweaks, and to bump audit-log retention to 90d for the rollout window. Can the RBAC/KMS owners ack and confirm who'll make the changes?

Mike: Ack. I can own the RBAC bindings. Which service accounts need signer perms vs deploy perms?

Caroline: @Mike good — signer perms should be narrowly scoped. Plan:
- orchard-signer-sa -> cosign:sign, keystore:encrypt (only from build cluster)
- orchard-deploy-sa -> image:pull, image:verify (prod/staging)

Tanvi: Quick Q on audit logs: Do we want the 90d retention in Cloud Logging or ship to ELK right away? I recommend keep 90d in Cloud Logging + export to SIEM for permanent storage.

Caroline: Yes — 90d hot in Cloud Logging so on-call can query, export all cosign and KMS access events to SIEM (s3/elk) for long-term. Tanvi: can you add export config?

Tanvi: Yep, will add a log export and a filter to capture: "resource.type=container" AND ("cosign" OR "kms" OR "keystore"). Will post config when ready.

Alex: Emergency rollback plan: if the new images fail, what's the procedure?

Caroline: Good call. Rollback plan:
1) Block new image promotion in the CI pipeline (api/ci flag).
2) Re-pin router config to previous image tag.
3) Trigger fleet restart via orchestration job with health-check gating.
4) If the signer SA keys are rotated, use the previously-signed image from the image registry (signed older tags).

Luis: I can run signer key rotation dry-run in staging tonight. Will validate cosign verify against both old and new keys.

sec-oncall: CVE walk-through: there's one medium CVE in a libc layer referenced by the rebuild. We already have backported patch in the base builder; ensure the rebuilt image includes the patched package. I'll push a quick vuln triage note to the ticket: https://redwood-internal/issue/SEC-2134

Caroline: Thanks — make sure the triage note includes the test that failed in QA. Also add the SLO for vulnerability density on the release checklist.

Mike: RBAC change plan sketch (will implement as IaC PR):
```yaml
- name: orchard-signer-binding
  kind: RoleBinding
  subjects:
    - kind: ServiceAccount
      name: orchard-signer-sa
  roleRef:
    apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
    kind: Role
    name: cosign-signer-role
```
I'll open the PR and tag @Tanvi and @sec-oncall for review.

Tanvi: FYI on logs export — snippet for cloud logging sink I will add:
```json
{
  "sink": "orchard-cosign-export",
  "filter": "resource.type=container AND (textPayload:cosign OR protoPayload.methodName:google.cloud.kms.*)",
  "destination": "storage.googleapis.com/redwood-siem-archive/orchard"
}
```
Will post PR shortly.

build-bot: Deploy scheduled: orchard-base-rebuild-staging START 2024-11-14T22:00:00Z (canary=10%). Logs: https://ci.redwood/orchard/12345

Caroline: Small ops note — please ensure the signer SA key material is stored only in KMS and access is via short-lived GRPC token. No persistent secrets in CI.

Luis: Confirmed. I'll test GRPC token flow and post a short runbook: how to rotate signer keys mid-rollout.

sec-oncall: If anything spikes in SIEM alerts during canary, escalate to sec-oncall and tag #incidents. Make sure PagerDuty rotation is set for the window.

Caroline: Action items: 
- @Mike: open RBAC IaC PR by EOD today.
- @Tanvi: add logs-sink PR and export filter.
- @Luis: staging dry-run signer rotation + runbook.
- @sec-oncall: vuln triage update in SEC-2134 + PD config.
- @Alex: draft rollback playbook with commands.

Caroline: Thanks all — I'll send a calendar invite for Thu 09:30 UTC pre-check and will post the final checklist here. :thumbsup:
